items.text: The receiving document maps each proposed first App question to its required claims/sources, stamp and reliance meanings, source-file route and accountable parties; every exact response/tool term is either backed by an identified agreement or explicitly retained under OI-022/TBD-001. No parser fixture descriptor is presented as the production response schema. Verified by VER-001.

verification.text: Inspect the receiving document against the accepted six scope rows, OI-022, the original seed/decision-06 clauses and CLM-005. Trace each question and required term to an agreement or explicit open item, and check fixture-to-contract provenance for unsupported schema promotion.

items.text: Adapter verification distinguishes a covered, qualified/released/adopted record-tier case from unqualified, unreleased, unadopted and outside-coverage cases; only the covered adopted case permits the advertised operational reliance, and all other cases expose the missing condition and source route without blocking independent work. Verified by VER-002.

verification.text: Exercise the adapter with cases varying qualification, release, receiving adoption and claim coverage; record each case's declared envelope, allowed receiving behavior and unsupported-condition/source-route result. Bind simulated cases to their declared assumptions and live cases to OUT-004.

items.text: Received-claim evidence exposes the examined-through pin, source reference, coverage, freshness, standing and limitations without conflating the three-field stamp with reliance declaration; missing, stale or unsupported metadata is visibly limited and is not converted into a complete/fresh/correct claim. Verified by VER-003.

verification.text: Compare received response values and source identities with the App-visible claim evidence for complete and missing/limited/stale cases. Inspect stamp versus reliance declaration and the coverage/freshness treatment against the agreed receiving semantics; report undecided comparisons as unexecuted with their input gap.

items.text: Presence-case evidence shows advisory standing and no correctness, execution, permission or human-ruling conclusion; record-tier cases retain their bounded reliance and source-authority distinction, and the receiving path creates no execution or governed decision on behalf of the owners. Verified by VER-004.

verification.text: Examine presence and record-tier fixtures plus the receiving code/interaction paths. Trace any correctness, execution, permission or human-decision outcome to its authority and inspect that PEC reception neither upgrades presence nor writes an owner act; check bounded record-tier use without an invented blanket source-reread gate.

items.text: For the same App coordination question, absent, stale, partial and failing PEC cases identify unsupported conclusions, the affected source-file route and the agent/manager/human responsibility handed to DEL-07-02; a totally absent response produces this receiving treatment without interpreting silence as empty work, readiness or permission. Verified by VER-005.

verification.text: Repeat the selected coordination question with absent, stale, partial and failing inputs, including no response. Inspect the adapter's limitation and source-route handoff to DEL-07-02, identify actual fallback responsibility from the contract and verify that independent supported work remains distinguishable from connector-dependent work.

items.text: The evidence account links actual provider identity, applicable qualification/release coverage and App adoption to the receiving contract, records any unsupplied inputs as pending, and preserves D108's ACCEPT_AS_IS/MAJOR/partly met meaning without asserting repair, release or adoption from it. Operational reliance is not claimed until the applicable OI-022 terms and evidence are established. Verified by VER-006.

verification.text: Audit the evidence account's identities and links against the actual provider contract, qualification/release evidence, consumer adoption and current OI-022/DEP-002 source records. Compare its D108 treatment with the actual decision; list missing inputs and decline an operational-reliance conclusion while any applicable prerequisite is unestablished.

items.text: The receiving contract, adapter responsibilities and verification assertions account for every excluded act in REQ-007 against its CLM-004 owner, with no provider, sibling, Piping, execution or human-decision act absorbed into this contribution and no restoration of the excluded old Runtime service presumed. Verified by VER-007.

verification.text: Perform an act-by-act boundary review of requirements, responsibility map, adapter paths and test assertions against CLM-004 and the accepted sibling/provider allocation. Record each excluded act and its owner, including human/external owners outside the deterministic deliverable-ID check; inspect for an assumed old Runtime bridge or transferred Piping adoption.

items.text: The fixture and witness record identifies the selected question and source pin, response and receiving action, maps performed checks to the applicable criteria and distinguishes simulated evidence from actual qualified/released/adopted operation; absent prerequisites and unexecuted checks are reported as pending with their missing input. Verified by VER-008.

verification.text: Audit the fixture/witness manifest and execution record against the selected question and V4-EXM-30 source-pin/response/action sequence. Check provenance, simulated-versus-actual labels, criterion coverage and each pending input; confirm fixture success is not used to assert provider delivery or operational adoption.
